sourceTitle: Helping teens learn, plan, and shape the future of AI
originalTitle: Helping teens learn, plan, and shape the future of AI
author: OpenAI

blocks.text: Since we introduced ChatGPT for Teens—the default experience automatically applied to accounts identified as under 18—we’ve seen young people use it to learn, explore ideas and solve everyday problems. Today, we’re sharing early progress on ChatGPT for Teens, including how teens are using its learning tools, along with new ways for teens to study and prepare for college.
blocks.en: Since we introduced ChatGPT for Teens—the default experience automatically applied to accounts identified as under 18—we’ve seen young people use it to learn, explore ideas and solve everyday problems. Today, we’re sharing early progress on ChatGPT for Teens, including how teens are using its learning tools, along with new ways for teens to study and prepare for college.
blocks.zh: 自推出 ChatGPT 青少年版以来，我们看到年轻人用它学习、探索想法并解决日常问题。这一默认体验会自动应用于被识别为未满 18 岁用户的账号。今天，我们将分享 ChatGPT 青少年版的初步进展，包括青少年如何使用其中的学习工具，以及帮助他们学习和为大学做准备的新方式。

blocks.text: ChatGPT’s 1.2 billion users span many countries, communities and backgrounds. That reach makes it especially important to build tools that help young people with different resources and opportunities learn and prepare for their futures.
blocks.en: ChatGPT’s 1.2 billion users span many countries, communities and backgrounds. That reach makes it especially important to build tools that help young people with different resources and opportunities learn and prepare for their futures.
blocks.zh: ChatGPT 的 12 亿用户来自不同国家/地区、社群和背景。如此广泛的用户覆盖，让我们更有必要开发工具，帮助资源和机会各不相同的年轻人学习，为未来做好准备。

blocks.text: What we’re seeing so far
blocks.en: What we’re seeing so far
blocks.zh: 目前的观察

blocks.text: ChatGPT for Teens is designed to help young people learn, think critically and deepen their understanding. As ChatGPT for Teens became available to more teens globally, those with access sent about 2.7 million more learning-related messages on average than those who didn’t have it yet.
blocks.en: ChatGPT for Teens is designed to help young people learn, think critically and deepen their understanding. As ChatGPT for Teens became available to more teens globally, those with access sent about 2.7 million more learning-related messages on average than those who didn’t have it yet.
blocks.zh: ChatGPT 青少年版旨在帮助年轻人学习、进行批判性思考并加深理解。随着 ChatGPT 青少年版逐步向全球更多青少年开放，已获得使用权限的青少年群体发送的学习相关消息，平均比尚未获得权限的群体多约 270 万条。

blocks.text: Once enrolled, teens use ChatGPT for Teens’ learning tools at scale. The most selected conversation starter prompts are “ask questions to develop my ideas,” “give feedback on my draft,” and “help me check my evidence.” In one week, nearly 1.2 million teens used Learning Visualizations to better understand math and science concepts, and more than 180,000 used Study Mode for step-by-step learning support.
blocks.en: Once enrolled, teens use ChatGPT for Teens’ learning tools at scale. The most selected conversation starter prompts are “ask questions to develop my ideas,” “give feedback on my draft,” and “help me check my evidence.” In one week, nearly 1.2 million teens used Learning Visualizations to better understand math and science concepts, and more than 180,000 used Study Mode for step-by-step learning support.
blocks.zh: 获得使用权限后，青少年开始广泛使用 ChatGPT 青少年版中的学习工具。最常被选择的对话开场提示词是“通过提问帮我完善想法”、“为我的草稿提供反馈”和“帮我核查论据”。在一周内，近 120 万名青少年使用了可视化学习功能，以更好地理解数学和科学概念；超过 18 万名青少年使用了学习模式，获得循序渐进的学习支持。

blocks.text: ChatGPT for Teens includes built-in reminders to encourage teens to take breaks. On average, teens spend under 15 minutes a day on ChatGPT. While less than 2% of teens spend more than three consecutive hours on ChatGPT, in almost half of teen conversations with a break reminder, teens took a break or ended their conversation within five minutes. These usage patterns remain well below the publicly reported average of 5 hours for teen social media usage, and reflect a different kind of experience: ChatGPT is designed for learning, building, and creativity, rather than passive scrolling. Among teens with sessions longer than three consecutive hours, over 80% had at least one prompt related to learning.
blocks.en: ChatGPT for Teens includes built-in reminders to encourage teens to take breaks. On average, teens spend under 15 minutes a day on ChatGPT. While less than 2% of teens spend more than three consecutive hours on ChatGPT, in almost half of teen conversations with a break reminder, teens took a break or ended their conversation within five minutes. These usage patterns remain well below the publicly reported average of 5 hours for teen social media usage, and reflect a different kind of experience: ChatGPT is designed for learning, building, and creativity, rather than passive scrolling. Among teens with sessions longer than three consecutive hours, over 80% had at least one prompt related to learning.
blocks.zh: ChatGPT 青少年版提供内置提醒，鼓励青少年适时休息。青少年平均每天使用 ChatGPT 的时间不到 15 分钟。连续使用 ChatGPT 超过三小时的青少年占比不到 2%；在出现休息提醒的青少年对话中，有近一半的对话在提醒出现后五分钟内被青少年暂停或结束。这些使用时长仍远低于公开报道中青少年使用社交媒体的平均时长（5 小时），也体现了不同的产品体验：ChatGPT 旨在支持学习、构建和创作，而非让用户被动地刷内容。在连续使用超过三小时的青少年中，超过 80% 至少发送过一条与学习相关的提示词。

blocks.text: These early signs are encouraging and we’ll continue to evaluate the experience and learn from teens, families and educators to improve ChatGPT for Teens.
blocks.en: These early signs are encouraging and we’ll continue to evaluate the experience and learn from teens, families and educators to improve ChatGPT for Teens.
blocks.zh: 这些初步迹象令人鼓舞。我们将继续评估使用体验，听取青少年、家庭和教育工作者的意见，改进 ChatGPT 青少年版。

blocks.text: Introducing College Planner to help teens prepare for what’s next
blocks.en: Introducing College Planner to help teens prepare for what’s next
blocks.zh: 推出大学申请规划工具，帮助青少年为下一阶段做好准备

blocks.text: Hundreds of thousands of US teens use ChatGPT each week to plan for college. They’re using it to plan applications, track deadlines, research schools and understand financial aid.
blocks.en: Hundreds of thousands of US teens use ChatGPT each week to plan for college. They’re using it to plan applications, track deadlines, research schools and understand financial aid.
blocks.zh: 每周都有数十万名美国青少年使用 ChatGPT 规划大学升学事宜。他们用它安排申请、跟踪截止日期、了解学校并弄清学生资助政策。

blocks.text: That’s why we’ll soon be adding College Planner to ChatGPT for Teens. We’re designing it to help students manage the practical steps of applying to college, without taking over the personal work of figuring out where they want to apply. Students have different levels of access to support with college applications. Our goal is to make help more accessible, regardless of financial circumstances, alongside guidance from counselors, advisers, and families.
blocks.en: That’s why we’ll soon be adding College Planner to ChatGPT for Teens. We’re designing it to help students manage the practical steps of applying to college, without taking over the personal work of figuring out where they want to apply. Students have different levels of access to support with college applications. Our goal is to make help more accessible, regardless of financial circumstances, alongside guidance from counselors, advisers, and families.
blocks.zh: 因此，我们即将在 ChatGPT 青少年版中加入大学申请规划工具。我们希望通过这款工具，帮助学生处理大学申请的具体步骤，而不是代替他们思考和决定自己想申请哪些学校。学生在申请大学时，能获得的支持各不相同。我们的目标是，在学校辅导员、升学顾问和家人的指导之外，让学生无论经济状况如何，都能更方便地获得帮助。

blocks.text: College Planner brings together application requirements, deadlines, tasks, and financial-aid steps for schools on a student’s list in one plan. Students applying to several colleges can return to it to update their progress, use the timeline to plan ahead and see what’s left to do. They can also ask ChatGPT questions along the way, from what a requirement means to how to get started. By bringing these steps together, we aim to save students and families time and make a stressful process feel more manageable.
blocks.en: College Planner brings together application requirements, deadlines, tasks, and financial-aid steps for schools on a student’s list in one plan. Students applying to several colleges can return to it to update their progress, use the timeline to plan ahead and see what’s left to do. They can also ask ChatGPT questions along the way, from what a requirement means to how to get started. By bringing these steps together, we aim to save students and families time and make a stressful process feel more manageable.
blocks.zh: 大学申请规划工具将学生意向学校的申请要求、截止日期、待办事项和学生资助申请步骤汇总到一份计划中。同时申请多所大学的学生可以随时回来更新进度，通过时间线提前规划，并查看还有哪些事项需要完成。在申请过程中，他们也可以随时向 ChatGPT 提问，无论是想弄清某项要求的含义，还是了解该如何着手。通过整合这些步骤，我们希望为学生和家庭节省时间，让原本充满压力的申请过程变得更容易应对。

blocks.text: We’re designing the initial US experience for high-school students in grades 10–12 who are planning to attend a four-year college. We plan to bring College Planner to students in more countries and expand support to two-year colleges, technical colleges, trade schools and more over time.
blocks.en: We’re designing the initial US experience for high-school students in grades 10–12 who are planning to attend a four-year college. We plan to bring College Planner to students in more countries and expand support to two-year colleges, technical colleges, trade schools and more over time.
blocks.zh: 首批面向美国推出的体验，将针对计划就读四年制大学的 10 至 12 年级高中生设计。我们计划将大学申请规划工具推广到更多国家/地区，并逐步支持两年制学院、技术学院、职业学校等更多院校类型。

blocks.text: College Planner also helps students figure out how to pay for college. They can get help understanding financial aid requirements, track each school’s aid deadlines, and explore scholarships and fee waivers.
blocks.en: College Planner also helps students figure out how to pay for college. They can get help understanding financial aid requirements, track each school’s aid deadlines, and explore scholarships and fee waivers.
blocks.zh: 大学申请规划工具还帮助学生了解如何支付大学费用。他们可以借助工具了解学生资助申请要求、跟踪各校学生资助申请截止日期，并探索奖学金和费用减免机会。

blocks.text: Keeping track of an application is only one part of preparing for college. Many students also need someone to help them make sense of their options. Alongside College Planner, we’re supporting College Advising Corps, a nonprofit that places recent college graduates as advisers in under-resourced high schools to help students navigate the path to higher education. OpenAI’s contribution will help the organization expand into new states and create an AI fellowship program. Through the fellowship, advisers across participating states will test and share practical ways to use AI to help more students navigate the path to college. AI can help students manage application and enrollment tasks. Advisers can help them consider their options and decide what to do next.
blocks.en: Keeping track of an application is only one part of preparing for college. Many students also need someone to help them make sense of their options. Alongside College Planner, we’re supporting College Advising Corps, a nonprofit that places recent college graduates as advisers in under-resourced high schools to help students navigate the path to higher education. OpenAI’s contribution will help the organization expand into new states and create an AI fellowship program. Through the fellowship, advisers across participating states will test and share practical ways to use AI to help more students navigate the path to college. AI can help students manage application and enrollment tasks. Advisers can help them consider their options and decide what to do next.
blocks.zh: 跟进申请进度只是大学入学准备的一部分。许多学生还需要有人帮助他们理清各种选择。除了推出大学申请规划工具，我们还在支持非营利组织 College Advising Corps。该组织将大学毕业不久的年轻人派往资源不足的高中担任顾问，帮助学生走上高等教育之路。OpenAI 的资助将帮助该组织把服务拓展到更多州，并设立 AI 研修项目。通过这一研修项目，参与州的顾问将探索并分享运用 AI 的实用方法，帮助更多学生走上大学求学之路。AI 可以帮助学生处理申请和入学事务。顾问则可以帮助他们权衡选择，决定下一步该怎么做。

blocks.text: “For students navigating the college application process, an unanswered question about a form, deadline, or fee can feel like a closed door. College Advising Corps advisers help students work through those moments with confidence. We see promise in College Planner as a tool that can help students prepare for those conversations, stay on track, and continue moving toward a college that is affordable and aligned with their goals.”
blocks.en: “For students navigating the college application process, an unanswered question about a form, deadline, or fee can feel like a closed door. College Advising Corps advisers help students work through those moments with confidence. We see promise in College Planner as a tool that can help students prepare for those conversations, stay on track, and continue moving toward a college that is affordable and aligned with their goals.”
blocks.zh: “对于正在申请大学的学生来说，表格、截止日期或费用方面的一个疑问若得不到解答，就可能让他们感到求学之门被关上了。College Advising Corps 的顾问帮助学生满怀信心地应对这些难题。我们看好大学申请规划工具的潜力：它可以帮助学生为与顾问的交流做好准备，按计划推进申请，继续朝着费用可负担、又符合自身目标的大学迈进。”

blocks.text: —Ekaterina Struett, CEO, College Advising Corps
blocks.en: —Ekaterina Struett, CEO, College Advising Corps
blocks.zh: —Ekaterina Struett，College Advising Corps 首席执行官

blocks.text: Supporting Boston Children’s Hospital to engage teens
blocks.en: Supporting Boston Children’s Hospital to engage teens
blocks.zh: 支持波士顿儿童医院推动青少年参与

blocks.text: When we introduced ChatGPT for Teens, we committed to keep improving the experience. We’re supporting Boston Children’s Hospital’s Digital Wellness Lab and its independent Student Advisory Council over the next three years to learn directly from young people about how AI fits into their lives and to give teenagers a meaningful stake at the table as AI is being designed.
blocks.en: When we introduced ChatGPT for Teens, we committed to keep improving the experience. We’re supporting Boston Children’s Hospital’s Digital Wellness Lab and its independent Student Advisory Council over the next three years to learn directly from young people about how AI fits into their lives and to give teenagers a meaningful stake at the table as AI is being designed.
blocks.zh: 在推出 ChatGPT 青少年版时，我们承诺会持续改善使用体验。未来三年，我们将支持波士顿儿童医院数字健康实验室及其独立的学生顾问委员会，直接向年轻人了解 AI 如何融入他们的生活，并让青少年在 AI 设计过程中真正拥有发言权。

blocks.text: For the 2026–27 school year, the Lab will bring together ~22 students across two tracks: ~12 students ages 14–18 working on digital wellbeing projects in their communities and ~10 students ages 16–20, focused on building AI chatbots and emerging technology. These students will work alongside researchers and clinicians on digital wellbeing and AI projects. Students in the AI track will test tools and recommend changes based on how they use AI in learning and their personal lives. We expect to seek feedback on teen safety defaults, parental controls and notifications and AI literacy.
blocks.en: For the 2026–27 school year, the Lab will bring together ~22 students across two tracks: ~12 students ages 14–18 working on digital wellbeing projects in their communities and ~10 students ages 16–20, focused on building AI chatbots and emerging technology. These students will work alongside researchers and clinicians on digital wellbeing and AI projects. Students in the AI track will test tools and recommend changes based on how they use AI in learning and their personal lives. We expect to seek feedback on teen safety defaults, parental controls and notifications and AI literacy.
blocks.zh: 2026–27 学年，实验室将招募约 22 名学生，分为两个方向：约 12 名 14 至 18 岁的学生在各自社区开展数字健康项目，另有约 10 名 16 至 20 岁的学生专注于 AI 聊天机器人的构建及新兴技术。这些学生将与研究人员和临床医生一起开展数字健康和 AI 项目。AI 方向的学生将测试工具，并根据自己在学习和个人生活中使用 AI 的情况提出改进建议。我们计划就青少年默认安全设置、家长控制与通知，以及 AI 素养等方面征求反馈。

blocks.text: Teens should play a central role in developing the tools that will shape their future. Teens will test tools and develop recommendations for the people building them. Our aim is to bring those recommendations into product and model decisions early and to report back to students on what we change and why. This advisory board will give them a direct voice in that work and share their insights and recommendations to help the wider industry build better tools for young people.
blocks.en: Teens should play a central role in developing the tools that will shape their future. Teens will test tools and develop recommendations for the people building them. Our aim is to bring those recommendations into product and model decisions early and to report back to students on what we change and why. This advisory board will give them a direct voice in that work and share their insights and recommendations to help the wider industry build better tools for young people.
blocks.zh: 这些工具将塑造青少年的未来，因此青少年应该在工具开发中发挥核心作用。青少年将测试工具，并向开发者提出建议。我们的目标是，在产品和模型决策的早期就纳入这些建议，并向学生反馈我们做了哪些改动以及原因。这个顾问委员会将让他们能够直接参与这项工作、表达意见，并分享见解和建议，帮助更广泛的行业为年轻人开发更好的工具。

blocks.text: “Young people bring critical insights and knowledge that adults don’t have. They see what works, what fails, and what needs to change.”
blocks.en: “Young people bring critical insights and knowledge that adults don’t have. They see what works, what fails, and what needs to change.”
blocks.zh: “年轻人拥有成年人所不具备的重要见解和知识。他们看得出什么有效、什么行不通，以及什么需要改变。”

blocks.text: —Dr. Michael Rich, Founder & Director and Cori Stott, Executive Director, Digital Wellness Lab, April 2026.
blocks.en: —Dr. Michael Rich, Founder & Director and Cori Stott, Executive Director, Digital Wellness Lab, April 2026.
blocks.zh: —Michael Rich 博士，数字健康实验室创始人兼主任；Cori Stott，数字健康实验室执行主任，2026 年 4 月。

blocks.text: More ways for teens to study with flashcards and quizzes
blocks.en: More ways for teens to study with flashcards and quizzes
blocks.zh: 通过记忆卡片和测验，为青少年提供更多学习方式

blocks.text: We heard from students that photographing and uploading their notes to ChatGPT can take hours. We’re making it easier for students to turn their notes into study materials like flashcards and quizzes.
blocks.en: We heard from students that photographing and uploading their notes to ChatGPT can take hours. We’re making it easier for students to turn their notes into study materials like flashcards and quizzes.
blocks.zh: 学生告诉我们，将笔记拍照并上传到 ChatGPT 可能需要几个小时。我们正在让学生更轻松地把笔记转化为记忆卡片、测验等学习材料。

blocks.text: With continuous, multi-photo capture, students can photograph multiple pages of notes and automatically combine them into a single PDF, ready to upload to ChatGPT. This is available on iOS, and we’re working to bring it to Android.
blocks.en: With continuous, multi-photo capture, students can photograph multiple pages of notes and automatically combine them into a single PDF, ready to upload to ChatGPT. This is available on iOS, and we’re working to bring it to Android.
blocks.zh: 借助连续多图拍摄功能，学生可以拍摄多页笔记，并自动将它们合并为一个 PDF 文件，随时上传到 ChatGPT。该功能已在 iOS 上推出，我们正在努力将其带到 Android。

blocks.text: We’re also adding flashcards to help teens practice what they’re learning. A student preparing for a biology test, for example, can upload class notes or choose a topic, and ChatGPT can turn the material into cards to review. They can mark the cards they know, return to the ones they missed or shuffle the deck for another round. Decks are saved in a teen’s Library, so it’s easy to pick up where they left off. Students can also ask ChatGPT to pull up the flashcards and create a scheduled task to practice them.
blocks.en: We’re also adding flashcards to help teens practice what they’re learning. A student preparing for a biology test, for example, can upload class notes or choose a topic, and ChatGPT can turn the material into cards to review. They can mark the cards they know, return to the ones they missed or shuffle the deck for another round. Decks are saved in a teen’s Library, so it’s easy to pick up where they left off. Students can also ask ChatGPT to pull up the flashcards and create a scheduled task to practice them.
blocks.zh: 我们还将新增记忆卡片，帮助青少年练习所学知识。例如，准备生物考试的学生可以上传课堂笔记或选择一个主题，ChatGPT 就能将相关材料制作成卡片，供他们复习。他们可以标记已经掌握的卡片，回顾答错的卡片，或打乱卡片顺序再练一轮。卡片组会保存在青少年的资料库中，方便他们接着上次的进度继续学习。学生也可以让 ChatGPT 调出记忆卡片，并创建定时任务来安排练习。

blocks.text: Alongside flashcards, we’ve made it easier to create Quizzes in ChatGPT. Students can now upload their notes to turn them into interactive quizzes, and ChatGPT is better at recognizing when you want a quiz and creating one directly in chat.
blocks.en: Alongside flashcards, we’ve made it easier to create Quizzes in ChatGPT. Students can now upload their notes to turn them into interactive quizzes, and ChatGPT is better at recognizing when you want a quiz and creating one directly in chat.
blocks.zh: 除了记忆卡片，我们也让在 ChatGPT 中创建测验变得更简单。现在，学生可以上传笔记，将其转化为互动测验。ChatGPT 也能更准确地识别你想要测验的意图，并直接在聊天中生成测验。

blocks.text: We’ll keep learning from teens, families and educators, checking how protections work in practice and sharing what we learn as ChatGPT for Teens evolves.
blocks.en: We’ll keep learning from teens, families and educators, checking how protections work in practice and sharing what we learn as ChatGPT for Teens evolves.
blocks.zh: 随着 ChatGPT 青少年版不断发展，我们将持续听取青少年、家庭和教育工作者的意见，检验保护措施在实际使用中的效果，并分享我们的发现。

keyPoints.en: Once enrolled, teens use ChatGPT for Teens’ learning tools at scale. The most selected conversation starter prompts are “ask questions to develop my ideas,” “give feedback on my draft,” and “help me check my evidence.” In one week, nearly 1.2 million teens used Learning Visualizations to better understand math and science concepts, and more than 180,000 used Study Mode for step-by-step learning support.

keyPoints.zh: ChatGPT 青少年版提供内置提醒，鼓励青少年适时休息。青少年平均每天使用 ChatGPT 的时间不到 15 分钟。
keyPoints.en: ChatGPT for Teens includes built-in reminders to encourage teens to take breaks. On average, teens spend under 15 minutes a day on ChatGPT.

original.title: Helping teens learn, plan, and shape the future of AI

zh.title: 帮助青少年开展学习、规划未来，并参与塑造 AI 的未来
